U1 traps the live toast. The live card body at toasts.html:161-168 holds a `toast-container position-fixed` element, which resolves z-index 1090 at rest (dist/src/bootstrap/index.css:5326-5329). U1's rule therefore adds `z-0` to it, because its exemptions name only dropdowns, modals, and offcanvas. `.card` is `position: relative` and a flex container (index.css:4330-4332), so a card body carrying `z-0` is a flex item that forms a stacking context. That context caps the fixed toast at layer 0, and every later card paints over the toast wherever it overlaps the viewport's bottom-right corner. The `toast` table's `Show the upload toast` rows click the toast's close control with a trusted click, which refuses a covered target. Fix: exempt any card that holds a live toast, and add the shown toast to U1's hit-order case.

The drawer slides in but snaps shut, which misses the user's 'collapses and expands gracefully'. `.offcanvas-lg` grants `visibility: visible` only to `.show`, `.showing`, and `.hiding` (dist/src/bootstrap/index.css:6431-6436), and `--bs-offcanvas-transition` covers only `transform` (:6193). So when `#fold` removes the `show` class, the panel hides in the same frame. `hiding` and `showing` are registry classes (src/core/constants.ts:1939, :1944). Fix: hold the `hiding` class until `transitionend` (instant under reduced motion) and make J3's folded reading wait for it. Otherwise, put the instant fold to the user as a ruling.

A plugin-wide option inside `createBootstrapPlugins()` moves the existing modal or collapse tables. `Veneer` routes each element to its nearest scope (src/browser/Veneer.ts:55-58), so a nested `createVeneer` scope over the Native group works as a route. The convention must name it, and both boot sites must compose it: app/browser/main.ts:10 and `startJourneyVeneer` at tests/setupBrowser.ts:3681. The refusal walk's `pointer-events: none` exemption keys on the `#interactions` section id (integration.test.ts:838; constants.ts:441), so that exemption must change in the same landing as the census `LIVE_GROUP` set.

The synthesis assumes a ruling on stylesheet fences without surfacing it. The verdict rules that 'The stylesheet fences never enter the showcase' (browser-stage-b-verdict.md:1158), and its B0-to-B6 no-row prediction rests on 'loads no fence' (:1147).
